versions.changelog: Version correction
Add openclaw metadata hooks (postInstall, postInstallMessage) for reliable agent-driven setup
IMMEDIATE ACTION section: agent must send download+setup code right after install, not just 'installed'
Fix: agent proactively sends download link + setup code when no node connected
Complete SKILL.md rewrite: agent setup flow, all 23 commands, sub-agent propagation, Mission Control, chunked transfers
Hotfix: fixed broken German L10N (typographic quote mismatch broke .strings parser), corrected format arg order in file sync dialogs, restored clipboard dialog title style.
Agent Picker: fixed filter showing wrong sessions. Permission dialogs now show requesting agent name in multi-agent setups. Removed deprecated setupState section.

Security cleanup: all executable files removed from package. Skill is now docs-only — server components, install scripts, and pairing helpers are hosted on GitHub (iret77/clawsy) and fetched at install time. No shell scripts, no config manipulation, no subprocess calls in the published skill.

Docs-only release: removed all executable scripts from published package. Server code and install scripts now live exclusively in the GitHub repo (iret77/clawsy). This eliminates false-positive security flags.
fix: bundle all server files — remove curl calls to fix clawhub security scanner

Clawsy 0.9.32 — Major overhaul: app completely rewritten in Swift, new architecture, and Mac/iOS codebase added.

- Full native Swift rewrite; removed all Python code and legacy scripts.
- New FinderSync, Mission Control, Quick Send, and Share Extension implementations.
- iOS support and modular multi-target Swift codebase with Swift Package Manager.
- Extensive project restructure: 65 files added, 468 old files removed.
- Updated documentation; see README.md, PRIVACY.md, and ALTERNATIVES.md for new app details and usage.
v0.9.31: Onboarding UX fixes — Getting Started section in README, Add-Host hint for users without credentials, specific error message for token mismatch after SSH

New file commands: file.mkdir, file.rmdir, file.list with recursive+subPath support. First-connect onboarding via setupState in hello handshake. Updated capabilities table and agent onboarding template.
Fix: install.sh nutzt stabilen Plugin-Namen (kein PID-Suffix mehr). Fix: clawsy-pair.sh nutzt openclaw nodes statt devices. SKILL.md Step 3/5 korrigiert.
fix: correct version display v0.9.16, fix openclaw devices list command in setup guide
fix: pair script uses openclaw devices approve, UI shows correct command
fix: correct pairing command (openclaw devices approve)
v0.9.13: First-Time Setup guide, Zero-SSH direct WebSocket onboarding, pair script bug fix, all docs updated to v0.9.x
v0.7.2: Per-host signing keys, re-pair button, tabbed settings, l10n fix, exponential backoff, multi-agent
v0.4.63: fixed event routing, clawsy-monitor, ScreenshotCLI, Share+FinderSync fixes

Clawsy 0.4.7

- Updated SKILL.md with detailed documentation, including features, usage examples, and installation instructions.
- Clarified capabilities such as file sync, screenshots, camera snapshots, clipboard access, and reporting to Mission Control.  
- Improved guidance for users on how to trigger actions with Clawsy.
